title: 豪华夏季宝丽来运动拼贴

categories: 社交媒体帖子,产品营销,摄影,复古 / 怀旧,肖像 / 自拍,网红 / 模特
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a premium luxury lifestyle social media campaign collage for a young East Asian woman, with a cohesive airy summer identity and editorial fashion storytelling.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, flat-lay view on warm champagne satin fabric with soft folds, creamy beige highlights, gentle shadows, and a polished luxury campaign feel.

Main subject: The same woman appears consistently across exactly 9 unique expressive lifestyle poses. She has dark brown messy updo hair with wispy bangs, delicate earrings and layered necklaces, soft natural makeup, and a sweet dreamy expression. Outfit is consistent: pale powder-blue oversized sweater, cream pleated mini skirt, white socks, white sneakers, and a small cream crossbody bag. Setting inside each photo is bright outdoor summer daylight with blue sky, soft clouds, greenery, road or railing details, and shallow-depth-of-field bokeh.

Layout: Arrange the 9 poses as an artistic mix of overlapping instant Polaroid prints, scattered 35mm film strips, and vintage photo booth strips rather than a strict grid. Use realistic paper thickness, curled corners, shadows, tape pieces, film perforations, handwritten captions, and slightly varied rotations. The arrangement should feel curated, editorial, and collectible.

Photo elements, exactly 9 unique poses:
1. Large left Polaroid: woman holding a small camera up to her face under a blue sky, captioned “Summer Breeze”.
2. Top-center black 35mm film strip: four tiny frames showing her in playful outdoor poses, including standing, sitting, and looking up.
3. Upper-right Polaroid: close-up portrait with chin resting on a sweater-covered hand, captioned “Blue days”.
4. Far upper-right black film frame: full-body walking pose against blue sky, handwritten caption “Every moment”.
5. Center Polaroid: close portrait blowing soap bubbles, captioned “Good things take time.”
6. Mid-right Polaroid: over-the-shoulder portrait with flower hair clip and soft sky background, captioned “You got this”.
7. Lower-center Polaroid: full-body joyful walking pose with arms open on a sunny road, captioned “Collect beautiful moments”.
8. Lower-right Polaroid: smiling close-up with cheek resting on hand, captioned “Sunshine on my mind”.
9. Tall right brown film strip: three stacked frames of the woman walking and posing along a road, captioned “Make today amazing”.

Additional decorative elements: Add exactly 3 white daisy-like flowers around the collage, scattered white and pale-pink petals, a few translucent soap bubbles, subtle lens sparkles, tiny gold coins or charms near the top edge, and small pieces of beige masking tape anchoring some prints.

Visual style: High-end fashion campaign, soft natural sunlight, pastel blue and cream color palette, realistic photographic collage, warm satin texture, refined shadows, delicate bokeh, premium lifestyle branding. Make all handwritten captions thin, casual, elegant, and legible.

Text customization: Use the visible captions as written, or replace the main campaign mood with summer breeze. Keep the overall palette centered on powder blue, the location feeling like a sunny outdoor road under a blue sky, and the brand tone as premium luxury lifestyle.

Constraints: No grid layout, no extra people, no logos, no watermark, no distorted hands or faces, no duplicated inconsistent identity, no excessive text beyond the listed captions.\

Canvas: Tall 9:16 poster, white and deep navy palette with gold accents, high-contrast cinematic sports lighting, premium trading-card / magazine-cover design. Background is a large illuminated football stadium with mist, crowd blur, and a clean futuristic white border frame.

Main subject: A hyper-realistic young male footballer in a white kit with dark navy trim, sprinting or striking forward toward the viewer. Use an extreme low-angle perspective: one boot sole is large in the foreground, the torso dominates the center, and a white football with navy/gold markings flies toward the bottom-right foreground. Add shattered glass shards, turf debris, dust, and dynamic impact fragments around the player to create a 3D breakout effect. The player’s face is intentionally covered by a plain soft-edged rectangular blur/solid mask, matching the generated poster.

Top typography: Huge bold dark navy Chinese headline reading 祖德·贝林厄姆. Add a tiny gold crown icon centered above the headline. Under it, a smaller spaced subtitle in Chinese: “英格兰新核 · 全能中场 · 领袖锋芒”, with thin gold horizontal divider lines at both sides.

Side data panels: Use exactly 8 dark navy information cards with gold outlines and beveled corners, 4 on the left and 4 on the right. Each card contains a simple gold/white tactical diagram, radar chart, silhouette, or stat graphic plus Chinese labels.
Left column, top to bottom: 1) “伯明翰起点” with a football pitch diagram and caption “少年崭露头角 / 天赋初现”; 2) “多特蒙德时期” with tactical arrows and caption “迅速成长为中场核心 / 展现全面能力”; 3) “皇马核心” with circular radar/orbit diagram and caption “登陆顶级舞台 / 掌控比赛节奏”; 4) “英格兰主力” with pitch-position graphic and caption “国家队中流砥柱 / 角色中场重任”.
Right column, top to bottom: 5) “中场全能属性” with a hexagonal radar chart labeled “传球, 防守, 盘带, 视野, 控球, 射门”; 6) “关键比赛高光” with pitch diagram and stars, caption “大场面先生 / 决定比赛走向”; 7) “进球与助攻能力” with big stats “28+” and “22+”, bar indicators, and captions “进球”, “助攻”, “持续贡献 / 数据见证影响力”; 8) “领袖气质” with a captain silhouette and caption “冷静沉着 | 自信坚定 / 以身作则 | 带动全队”.

Bottom timeline: Add one wide dark navy and gold career timeline panel across the bottom with exactly 5 timeline points and one gold trophy icon near the right. The 5 labeled points are: “2003 / 伯明翰 / 足球启蒙”; “2019—2020 / 多特蒙德 / 崭露头角”; “2023—至今 / 皇马核心 / 中场领袖”; “2020—至今 / 英格兰主力 / 大赛担当”; “未来可期 / 足坛新传奇 / 正在书写”.

Footer: Large metallic gold Chinese slogan across the very bottom: 新生代巨星破框档案. Use embossed block lettering, navy shadow, and angular gold trim.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic sports photo composite, dramatic depth of field, sharp player and ball details, navy-and-gold infographic overlays, clean Chinese editorial typography, cinematic stadium haze, collectible poster finish. Keep all visible text in Chinese exactly as specified, avoid logos, avoid club crests, avoid watermarks, and maintain a premium World Cup star-poster feel.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cream-toned 3D editorial data visualization poster about 2020–2026 中国离婚人数, showing divorce counts in China with a refined miniature diorama style.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 2:1 composition, warm off-white paper background with subtle grain, soft shadows, minimalist premium infographic aesthetic. Use a muted cream, black, terracotta, sage, ochre, and beige palette.

Layout: Place the main title on the upper left in large elegant black serif Chinese typography. Under it, add the subtitle 全国依法办理离婚手续 with a thin horizontal rule ending in a small orange dot. The central focus is a black oval/cylindrical stage platform spanning the lower middle of the image, viewed in slight perspective. On the platform, arrange exactly 7 year positions from left to right: 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026.

Data bars: Show exactly 5 solid rectangular 3D vertical bars for years 2020–2024 and exactly 2 dashed-outline placeholder bars for 2025 and 2026. Use these visible values and labels: 2020 ochre-gold tall bar labeled 433.9; 2021 terracotta bar labeled 283.9 with a small callout tag reading “2021 低点”; 2022 muted sage-green bar labeled 287.9; 2023 salmon-pink bar labeled 360.53 with a small callout tag reading “2023 回升”; 2024 beige bar labeled 351.3; 2025 dashed empty bar with a hanging tag reading “待更新”; 2026 dashed empty bar with a hanging tag reading “待更新”. Put each year label in white or pale text along the front face of the black platform beneath its position.

Supporting visual elements: Include exactly 2 miniature human figures: one standing near the left side of the stage railing looking toward the chart, and one standing on the right side near the 2026 area. Include a delicate small tree with thin branches near the 2020 bar. Add one large warm yellow sun circle in the upper right. Add a tall cream rectangular architectural block at the far right behind the platform. At the lower left foreground, add exactly 3 desk-like props: one semicircular wood block, one off-white paper sheet with faint chart lines and an orange dot, and one small pale green cube. On the front lower center of the platform, add one small beige inset chart card showing a simple black line chart with an orange dot.

Legend and text: In the bottom-left corner, add an orange dot followed by “单位：万对”. Keep all Chinese text crisp and readable. Use the data source/style as a polished social-media infographic, not a scientific chart.

Style constraints: Soft natural lighting, realistic paper and plaster textures, subtle 3D depth, clean negative space, no watermark, no extra years, no extra bars, no additional text beyond the specified labels. Use warm ivory as the overall background tone and orange for dots and highlights.\

[Typography]
- If the text is in English or romaji: handwritten brush script style — loose, expressive, confident strokes, imperfect and alive
- If the text is in Japanese: calligraphic brushwork by a master — rough, bold, spontaneous ink strokes with natural variation in pressure and thickness
- Scale: large and dominant — the text is a visual element, not a label
- Color: choose a color that does not clash with or duplicate the background — prioritize visual harmony over legibility

[Layer Depth — Critical Rule]
- The text must appear BEHIND the main subject (person, figure, or foreground object)
- The main subject occludes the text naturally — as if the subject is standing in front of the text
- The background remains behind both the text and the subject
- If any other text elements exist in the image (watermarks, captions, body copy, small text), the title must appear in front of all of them
- Layer order from back to front: background → existing text elements → title text → subject

[Legibility — Important]
- Do not force the text to be readable
- It is acceptable — even desirable — for portions of the text to be hidden behind the subject
- The text exists as a design element and compositional layer, not as information to be read
- Layout and aesthetic integration take priority over legibility at all times

[Placement]
- The text spans large across the image, partially hidden behind the subject
- Placement feels cinematic and intentional — like a movie poster or editorial cover
- Allow the text to bleed beyond the frame edges naturally
- Do not generate random text blocks, body copy, or filler text anywhere in the image
- Only the specified title text should appear as a new addition

[Style Preservation]
- Do not alter the subject, colors, or composition of the original image
- Add only the text layer — nothing else\

prompt_en:
Subject:
Desert White Wind

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige skin with natural texture and a hint of pink. Soft highlights on cheeks, nose tip, shoulders, and collarbones. Pale rose-pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long thin lashes, natural undereye bags, light brown eyebrows, and sheer pink-beige lip gloss. Eyes with small, clear catchlights. Looking at the camera with a calm, confident, and slightly cool gaze.

Clothing/Pose:
Light milk-tea ash-brown medium-long hair with see-through bangs, layers, and ends curled inward, with fine wisps blowing in the wind. A light brown straw cowboy hat. A white to ivory cropped western shirt tied in the front, with delicate stitching, small metal studs, and a decorative yoke line. A black bikini top underneath. Blue denim shorts with fringe, subtle distressing, side studs, a thick brown leather belt, and a large engraved buckle. Standing coolly with the body angled and hips shifted. Touching the brim of the hat with the right hand and resting the left hand near the belt.

Background/Light:
A straight road in a dry desert. Sandy ground and low grass in the foreground; sparse cacti and shrubs in the midground; reddish-brown mesas and rocky mountains in the background. Vivid blue sky with white clouds drifting horizontally. Strong midday sun from the upper left casting a thin shadow from the hat brim onto the face. Bright reflections on the shirt, skin, and denim. Shadows fall toward the bottom right; the background has a bright, dry atmosphere.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Fashion portrait from mid-thigh to above the head. The person is slightly right of center, creating a diagonal flow. Leave some space above the hat and include the waist and belt at the bottom. Camera is slightly low, around chest height, looking up. Shallow depth of field to softly blur the background, focusing on the face and clothing details.

Texture/Style:
Realistic photography style. Elegant and cool finish like a fashion editorial from an overseas shoot. Skin is not overly retouched, leaving natural pores and a soft glow. Detailed depiction of individual hair strands, shirt seams, denim fraying, and the leather and metal textures of the belt. Emphasis on the contrast between the blue sky, dry sand, white shirt, black top, and milk-tea brown hair.

Negative:
Underage-looking expressions, unnatural face or gaze, excessive exposure, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, extra or missing fingers, fused fingers, broken joints, poor contact with hat or clothes, floating hands, distorted belt, broken denim, shadows inconsistent with light source, unnatural perspective, unwanted people, text, logos, watermarks.\
